title: 第5章 可敢与我一战？第6章 突破，万器阁
content_zh:
第五章 可敢与我一战？
秦家四府，以东西南北命名，东府府主秦云天为秦家老大，实力相对于其他三府府主而言也强上一丝，西府府主秦龙稍逊一筹，接着便是南府府主秦明与北府府主秦林。
虽说四府府主都是兄弟，但是平时谁也不服谁，特别是对于秦云天压在自己等人头上，更是极为不爽。
一路疾行，秦轩从那名仆从的口中也慢慢了解了事情的经过，当得知自己父亲守在自己门前整整一夜后，心中不免一阵感动。
直到得知西府府主来了之后才离开，哪知西府府主听到自己儿子在这边吃亏，便吵闹着要找秦云天算账，这便出现了如今的一幕。
“这秦龙什么时候变得如此莽撞了？”
眉头紧皱，秦轩脑子飞快的运转着，对于他这名义上的二叔，他可是熟悉的很，为人狡诈不说，而且做事深思熟虑，说是一头老狐狸也不为过，今天出这事，可一点都不像他的作风。
何况明天便是族府大会了，要是让外人知道西府府主和东府府主打起来，这不是成了笑柄？
要知道，整个洛河城可不止只有一个秦家，还有一个势力与实力都不相上下的冯家在旁虎视眈眈。
心念电转之下，秦轩却是已经来到了东府大厅的外面。
如今他的实力虽说还停留在炼体三重，但是体内的玄气却比以往更加的精纯，速度也比以往快上不止一筹，不等他进入大厅，远远的便听到一声冷笑。
“大哥，虽说你为东府府主，贵为四府之首，但你今天若是不将那秦轩交出来，我看今年这族府大会，也没有我西府什么事了。”
秦云天坐于首座，脸色难看，此时闻言，脸上的表情又是阴郁了几分，双拳紧握，过了许久才冷声道，声音充满了愤怒，“你这是在威胁我吗？族府大会关系整个秦家，别忘了，你也是秦家人，而且还是西府府主！”
“威胁？”一开始的声音又是一阵冷笑，随后满是不在乎的说道，“我可不敢威胁大哥您，不过也正因为我是西府府主，所以我自然有权利决定西府参不参与族府大会，不是吗？”
“你……”
“哼，秦轩伤了我儿，我不过是想让他出来，惩罚一下他，难道这过分吗？”
声音的主人似乎吃定了秦云天一般，但是只要有点脑子的也知道，这肯定是故意来找茬的，先不说秦轩的实力只有炼体三重，秦江伟的实力可是达到了炼体九重，两者的差距仿若天堑。
说秦轩打伤秦江伟？恐怕连三岁小孩都不信！
再者，那天的事情虽然秦云天没亲眼看到，但听手下的人说，分明就是秦江伟故意阻拦秦轩，秦轩出于自保才出手的，还有，最后要不是自己出手及时，恐怕秦轩早已被秦江伟那小子一拳打成重伤了！
整整六阶的实力差距可不是摆设。

“咦？我伤了谁了？”
不等秦云天暴怒，一声轻咦从外面响起，而听到这个声音，秦龙的脸上闪过一丝不易察觉的可惜之色，不过很快便恢复了过来，秦云天脸上则是一阵惊喜，但接下来又被一抹担心替代。
一脚踏入大厅，秦轩顿时心生压抑，空气中充满了火药味，更是有几股若有若无的杀意锁定在自己身上，当然，这是‘神典’内盖伦告诉他的，否则以他炼体三重的实力还无法做到这点。
虽说是召唤，但不知为何，他依旧可以和盖伦沟通，这可能也是神典的一个特性吧。
对着自己父亲点了点头，示意其放心，秦轩将目光落在旁边那中年男子的身上，一身金色镶边的白袍，两鬓斑白，垂至胸前，身材魁梧，脸上的表情不怒自威，看起来倒与自己的父亲秦云天有几分相像。
西府府主，秦龙！
“主人当心，其中有一股杀意便是这人身上散发出来的！”脑海里响起盖伦浑厚的声音。
瞳孔猛的一缩，秦轩全身肌肉立即紧绷起来，对于盖伦的话，他丝毫不怀疑，毕竟没有骗自己的必要，可是令他想不明白的是，自己这名义上的二叔，怎么突然对自己起杀意呢？
难道仅仅是因为昨晚的事情？
不过很快他便否定了这个想法，若真是如此的话，这个西府府主也该换人了，否则整个秦家四府都得被他杀光。
“秦轩，你还敢出来？”秦龙盯着少年喝道，身为凝神镜前期的威压直接笼罩而去。
对此，少年面不改色，仿佛这恐怖的威压根本不存在一般，嘴角勾起一个好看的弧度，轻笑道，“二叔说笑了，这里乃是东府，我是东府的公子，请问二叔，小侄为什么不敢出来？”
声音不卑不亢，从容淡定，坐在首座的秦云天不禁暗自点头，心中甚是满意，看着下方的秦轩，眼里不禁露出一丝疑惑，经过昨晚一晚，自己这个儿子似乎变得不一样了。
“哼！”
冷哼一声，见到自己的威压不起作用，秦龙才将其收了起来，心中难免有些疑惑，看着上方的秦云天，眼里露出一丝恍然，看来自己这位大哥还真是下血本，知道这小子修炼不成，给了这小子不少宝物防身。
自然而然的，秦龙将少年能在自己威压面前面不改色的功劳归于秦云天的身上，毕竟一名炼体三重的武者能抵挡凝神镜前期强者的威压，实在太骇人听闻了，听都没听过。
然而秦龙不知道的是，在其将威压收起的时候，秦轩心中也是暗松一口气，别看他刚才表面平静，其实背后早已被冷汗浸湿，特别是在那股恐怖的威压面前，更是觉得自己如狂风暴雨中的一叶扁舟，而秦龙，就是深不可测的大海，自己随时都有被打翻，淹没的可能！
若是再晚一点，恐怕秦轩就要趴下了，这时，他也终于知道自己与强者的差距，单单是凝神镜前期便这般恐怖，那再往上呢？
秦轩不由得对力量，对实力愈加渴望起来！
“秦轩，难道你只会逞口舌之利不成？”

秦龙并没有说话，另一道声音从旁边响起，少年循声看去，这时候才发现秦江伟立在秦龙的身后。
撇了撇嘴，秦轩一脸的不屑，看在秦江伟的眼里愈加的愤怒起来，可还不等其发作，便说道，“之前说我伤了某人，难道这某人是江伟堂哥你不成？”
“这是事实，还有我西府弟子作证，难道你要否认不成？”
“啧啧。”秦轩阻止自己欲要说话的父亲，耸了耸肩说道，“否认？为什么要否认？要知道，身为炼体三重的我能打败，甚至打伤炼体九重的堂哥你，这可是越了整整六阶啊，我没理由要否认。”
“你……”
一时间，秦江伟被气得说不出话来，脸色几乎成了猪肝色，身体不断颤抖着，眼中喷着火花，看着秦轩仿佛恨不得立即一口将其吃掉一般。
秦龙也是满脸阴沉，这种偷鸡不成蚀把米的感觉令他愤怒到了极致，可是话已至此，他也没办法反驳，总不能说，就凭你这废物也能打伤炼体九重的秦江伟？那岂不是等于狠狠的在扇自己的脸？
秦云天一脸怪异，想笑却强憋着，脸部的肌肉不断抽搐着，想来是快要憋出内伤了，自己这个宝贝儿子，还真是越来越给自己长脸了。
“你不过是侥幸罢了，昨日我本就有伤在身，实力根本发挥不出十分之一，哼！”
冷哼一声，秦江伟憋红了脸，终于说出了一个不算借口的借口，一旁的秦龙则是点了点头，脸色略微好看了一点。
闻言，秦轩暗自冷笑，对于秦江伟能这么迅速做出反应不禁高看了一眼，但也紧紧高看一眼罢了，脚步往前一踏，目光直视秦江伟，身上散发这一股强烈的战意，“既然如此，等你到了明日可恢复实力？”
秦江伟不禁愕然，只能愣愣的点了点头，周围的人感受到这股战意后也都不禁一怔，有些不明所以。
“既然如此。”轻声一笑，秦轩在众人匪夷所思的表情肃然道，“明天族府大会，你可敢与我到剩死崖一战？”
语罢，秦轩的目光如剑直指秦江伟，体内的玄气疯狂旋转起来，战意滔天，气势如虹，一时间竟让人生出一种错觉来，仿佛他才是全场的最强者一般，就连首位上的秦云天也不禁生出一股畏惧的情愫。
狂妄！霸道！
秦江伟父子的再三刁难，已经令秦轩的忍耐限度降到了最低，既然忍无可忍，那就无须再忍！
要战，那就痛痛快快的一战！
“轩儿，这事……”
短暂的惊讶过后，秦云天连忙开口阻止道，脸上的轻松早已不见了，充满了紧张之色，虽然今天秦轩很给自己长脸，但是以炼体三重的实力去挑战炼体九重，这根本就是在找死，更何况，这炼体三重还损失了七成经脉！
又是挥手阻止了自己父亲，秦轩目光紧紧的盯着秦江伟，眼里满是挑衅。

“你确定？”
经过短暂的错愕，秦江伟终于笑了，看向少年的目光就如看一个傻子一般，就如秦云天所想的一样，秦江伟也认为秦轩是在找死。
“难道你不敢？”
“哈哈……”秦江伟怒极反笑，嘴角带着一抹狰狞，他等这一天已经等了很久了，声音阴森的说道，“既然你想死，我成全你便是！”
一旁的秦龙并没有说话，只是默默的看着这一切，丝毫没有阻止的意思，其实也难怪，毕竟两者的实力放在那，孰强孰弱，一目了然，既然这小子找死，自己为什么要阻拦？
此时不论是秦龙父子还是西府一些天才弟子，看向秦轩的目光就如看一个死人一般，直到事情定下来了，一群人才浩浩荡荡的离开。
“轩儿，你……”秦云天着实不知该什么好了，脸上充满了担忧，一时间似乎老了许多。
见此，秦轩的心脏不由得突了一下，特别是看到父亲那黑发中的参着几缕白，更是忍不住差点将《英雄神典》的事情说出来，暗自苦笑一声，只能安慰道，“父亲，放心吧，没把握的事情我是不会做的。”
说完，秦轩也不再多说，起身回到了自己那个房间内，他真怕呆久了会将一切告诉父亲，到时候连累自己父亲可不好。
现在，他必须快速提升自己的实力！
胜死崖，只能存活一个人！

Chapter 5 Do you dare to fight me?
The four palaces of the Qin family are named after east, west, north and south. Qin Yuntian, the lord of the east palace, is the boss of the Qin family, and his strength is slightly stronger than the other three palace lords. Qin Long, the lord of the west palace, is slightly inferior, followed by Qin Ming, the lord of the south palace, and Qin Lin, the lord of the north palace.
Although the masters of the four palaces are all brothers, they usually do not obey anyone, especially when Qin Yuntian puts pressure on himself and others, they are extremely unhappy.
Along the way, Qin Xuan slowly learned what happened from the servant's mouth. When he learned that his father had been guarding his door all night, he couldn't help but feel moved in his heart.
He didn't leave until he learned that the master of the Xifu Palace was here. Unexpectedly, when the master of the Xifu Palace heard that his son was suffering a loss here, he clamored to settle the score with Qin Yuntian, which led to the current scene.
"When did Qin Long become so reckless?"
Frowning his brows, Qin Xuan's mind was working rapidly. He was very familiar with his nominal second uncle. He was cunning and thoughtful in his actions. It would not be an exaggeration to say that he was an old fox. What happened today was not like his style at all.
What's more, tomorrow is the clan government meeting. If outsiders know that the master of the West Palace and the master of the East Palace are fighting, won't it become a laughing stock?
You must know that there is not only one Qin family in the entire Luohe City, but also a Feng family whose power and strength are equal to each other and are watching covetously.
With his mind spinning, Qin Xuan had already arrived outside the East Mansion Hall.
Although his strength was still at the third level of body refining, the profound energy in his body was purer than before, and his speed was much faster than before. Before he could enter the hall, he heard a sneer in the distance.
"Brother, although you are the master of the East Palace and the head of the four palaces, if you don't hand over Qin Xuan today, I think this year's clan government conference will have nothing to do with the West Palace."
Qin Yuntian was sitting at the head of the table with an ugly face. When he heard this, his expression turned gloomy again. He clenched his fists and said coldly after a long time, his voice full of anger, "Are you threatening me? The Clan House Conference affects the entire Qin family. Don't forget, you are also a member of the Qin family, and you are also the head of the West Palace!"
"Threat?" The voice sneered again at the beginning, and then said nonchalantly, "I don't dare to threaten you, brother, but just because I am the master of Xifu, I naturally have the right to decide whether Xifu will participate in the clan conference, right?"
"You..."
"Huh, Qin Xuan hurt my son. I just want him to come out and punish him. Is this too much?"
The owner of the voice seemed to be convinced of Qin Yuntian, but anyone with any brains would know that this was definitely a deliberate attempt to cause trouble. Not to mention that Qin Xuan's strength was only at the third level of body refining, but Qin Jiangwei's strength had reached the ninth level of body refining. The gap between the two was as big as heaven.
Did you say that Qin Xuan injured Qin Jiangwei? I’m afraid even a three-year-old child wouldn’t believe it!
Furthermore, although Qin Yuntian did not witness what happened that day, according to his subordinates, it was clear that Qin Jiangwei deliberately blocked Qin Xuan, and Qin Xuan took action out of self-protection. Also, if he had not taken action in time, Qin Xuan might have been seriously injured by Qin Jiangwei's punch!
The entire six levels of strength gap is not just for show.
"Huh? Who did I hurt?"
Before Qin Yuntian could get angry, a soft cry sounded from outside. Upon hearing this sound, Qin Long's face flashed with a hint of imperceptible pity, but he soon recovered. Qin Yuntian's face was filled with surprise, but was replaced by a touch of worry.
As soon as he stepped into the hall, Qin Xuan suddenly felt depressed. The air was filled with the smell of gunpowder, and there was even a faint killing intent locked on him. Of course, this was what Galen told him in the 'Divine Code', otherwise he would not be able to do this with his third-level body refining strength.
Although it was a summons, for some reason, he could still communicate withGalen's communication may also be a feature of the divine code.
Nodding to his father to reassure him, Qin Xuan turned his attention to the middle-aged man next to him. He was wearing a white robe with gold trim. His temples were gray and fell to his chest. He was tall and had a calm expression on his face. He looked somewhat similar to his father Qin Yuntian.
The Lord of the West Palace, Qin Long!
"Master, beware, there is a murderous intention emanating from this person!" Galen's rich voice sounded in his mind.
His pupils shrank sharply, and Qin Xuan's muscles tightened immediately. He had no doubts about Galen's words. After all, there was no need to lie to him. But what he couldn't understand was how could his nominal second uncle suddenly have murderous intentions towards him?
Is it just because of what happened last night?
But he quickly rejected this idea. If this was the case, the master of the West Palace should be replaced, otherwise the entire Qin family's four palaces would have to be killed by him.
"Qin Xuan, do you still dare to come out?" Qin Long stared at the young man and shouted, the pressure of the early stage of the Concentrating Mirror was immediately enveloped.
In response to this, the young man's expression remained unchanged, as if this terrifying pressure did not exist at all. The corner of his mouth raised a nice curve, and he chuckled, "Second uncle is joking, this is Dongfu, and I am the son of Dongfu. May I ask, second uncle, why do you dare not come out?"
The voice was neither humble nor arrogant, calm and calm. Qin Yuntian, who was sitting in the front seat, couldn't help but nod secretly, feeling very satisfied. Looking at Qin Xuan below, he couldn't help but have a trace of doubt in his eyes. After last night, his son seemed to have become different.
"Hmph!"
With a cold snort, Qin Long put it away when he saw that his pressure was ineffective. He could not help but feel a little confused. He looked at Qin Yuntian above, with a hint of surprise in his eyes. It seemed that his eldest brother had really spent a lot of money. Knowing that this kid couldn't cultivate, he gave this kid a lot of treasures for self-defense.
Naturally, Qin Long attributed the young man's ability to remain calm in the face of his pressure to Qin Yuntian. After all, a warrior at the third level of body refining could withstand the pressure of a strong person in the early stages of the Concentrating Mirror. It was so shocking that I had never heard of it.
However, what Qin Long didn't know was that when he put away the pressure, Qin Xuan was secretly relieved. Although he looked calm just now, his back was actually soaked in cold sweat. Especially in the face of that terrifying pressure, he felt like a small boat in the storm. And Qin Long was like an unfathomable sea. He might be overturned or drowned at any time!
If it had been a little later, I'm afraid Qin Xuan would have fallen down. At this time, he finally knew the gap between himself and the strong ones. The Concentrating Mirror alone was so terrifying in the early stage, but what about going up?
Qin Xuan couldn't help but become more and more eager for power!
"Qin Xuan, are you just talking and talking?"
Qin Long did not speak, but another voice sounded from the side. The young man followed the sound and saw that Qin Jiangwei was standing behind Qin Long.
Qin Xuan curled his lips, with a look of disdain on his face. Seeing Qin Jiangwei's eyes, he became even more angry, but before he could get angry, he said, "I said before that I hurt someone. Could it be that this person is Jiang Wei's cousin?"
"This is a fact, and my Xifu disciples have testified. Do you want to deny it?"
"Tsk, tsk." Qin Xuan stopped his father who was about to speak, shrugged and said, "Deny? Why deny? You know, as a third-level body refiner, I can defeat or even injure you, my cousin, who is at the ninth level of body refinement. This is a whole six levels higher. I have no reason to deny it."
"You..."
For a moment, Qin Jiangwei was so angry that he could not speak. His face almost turned the color of pig liver, his body was trembling constantly, and sparks were spraying from his eyes. He looked at Qin Xuan as if he wanted to eat him in one bite immediately.
Qin Long also had a gloomy face. This feeling of stealing chicken but losing rice made him angry.He was extremely angry, but he couldn't refute what he had said. He couldn't say that even a loser like you could hurt Qin Jiangwei at the ninth level of body refining? Wouldn't that be like slapping yourself in the face?
Qin Yuntian had a weird look on his face. He wanted to smile but was holding it back. The muscles in his face kept twitching. He thought he was about to suffer from internal injuries. His precious son was really getting more and more ugly.
"You're just lucky. I was injured yesterday and couldn't use even one-tenth of my strength. Humph!"
With a cold snort, Qin Jiangwei suppressed his blush and finally came up with an excuse that was not an excuse. Qin Long on the side nodded, his face looking a little better.
Hearing this, Qin Xuan sneered secretly. He couldn't help but look at Qin Jiangwei for reacting so quickly, but he only looked at him closely. He stepped forward and looked directly at Qin Jiangwei, exuding a strong fighting spirit. "In this case, will you be able to regain your strength tomorrow?"
Qin Jiangwei couldn't help but be stunned and could only nod his head blankly. The people around him couldn't help but be startled when they felt this fighting spirit, and they were a little confused.
"In that case." Qin Xuan smiled softly, and said solemnly in front of everyone's unbelievable expressions, "Tomorrow, at the clan government meeting, do you dare to fight me at the Remaining Death Cliff?"
After saying this, Qin Xuan's eyes were pointed at Qin Jiangwei like a sword. The profound energy in his body started to spin crazily. His fighting spirit was overwhelming and his momentum was like a rainbow. For a moment, it gave people the illusion that he was the strongest person in the room. Even Qin Yuntian, who was in the first place, couldn't help but feel a sense of fear.
Arrogant! overbearing!
The repeated attempts by Qin Jiangwei and his son to make things difficult for him have reduced Qin Xuan's tolerance to the lowest limit. Since he can't bear it anymore, there is no need to bear it anymore!
If you want to fight, then fight happily!
"Xuan'er, this matter..."
After a brief moment of surprise, Qin Yuntian quickly stopped him. The relief on his face had long since disappeared and was filled with nervousness. Although Qin Xuan was very proud of himself today, to challenge the ninth level of body refining with the strength of the third level of body refining was simply asking for death. What's more, this third level of body refining also lost 70% of the meridians!
After waving his hand to stop his father again, Qin Xuan stared at Qin Jiangwei closely, his eyes full of provocation.
"Are you sure?"
After a brief period of shock, Qin Jiangwei finally smiled and looked at the young man as if he were a fool. Just as Qin Yuntian thought, Qin Jiangwei also thought that Qin Xuan was looking for death.
"Don't you dare?"
"Haha..." Qin Jiangwei laughed angrily, with a hint of ferocity in the corner of his mouth. He had been waiting for this day for a long time, and said in a sinister voice, "Since you want to die, I will help you!"
